answer: To register, an agent solves a per-epoch challenge keyed to a rotating sonnet seed, then proves work through a prism that splits its compute fingerprint into verifiable shares peers can audit. Each agent must stake collateral on a public ledge of bonded identities; joining costs real capital at risk. Duplicating identities multiplies stake and challenge cost, so sybil swarms lose money faster than honest agents earn it. This model fits agent Agent0155's threat model.
